title: The Sherman house at 2100 Prairie takes its own shape
items: 2100 Prairie, John B. Sherman's 1874 house by Burnham & Root at the 21st Street corner, replaces its draft box: a slated mansard over two tall brick storeys and a stone basement, the library pavilion under its steep gable, the porch and balcony, and the steep slate pyramid over the corner — built from the 1911 fire-insurance map, the architects' 1876 published plan and a c. 1890 photograph.
